context_requirements: Expression of SLC6A2 (NET) or other monoamine transporters on the cell surface
Intact noradrenergic signaling machinery (adrenergic receptors, downstream second messengers)
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage; none of the nine tested lines are neuronal
For any off-target transcriptional effect, concentrations well above 10 micromolar may be required
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar treatment in any of the nine lines
Upregulation of canonical adrenergic/cAMP-responsive genes (e.g., FOS, JUN, EGR1, NR4A family) in a pattern consistent with SLC6A2 inhibition
Concentration-dependent growth inhibition or apoptosis across multiple lines at 10 micromolar

evidence.supports: Venlafaxine alters placental SERT/Slc6a4 expression in vivo, showing transporter-mediated transcriptional effects require relevant tissue context
Milnacipran suppresses appetite and increases hypothalamic POMC/CART mRNA, indicating central neuronal targets absent from the tested cell lines
Duloxetine shows anticancer and immunomodulatory activity in cancer cell lines, but effects are likely off-target and not mediated by norepinephrine reuptake inhibition
Duloxetine may directly bind pSTAT3 and modulate STAT3 signaling, a pleiotropic off-target mechanism independent of SLC6A2
Duloxetine combined with paclitaxel affects CDK1 and apoptosis in ovarian cancer cells, suggesting context-dependent off-target effects
